parts.title: Grandfather's chess set
parts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer for each question.
parts.passage:
Every Saturday afternoon, my grandfather and I sit at the kitchen table and play chess. It is our special time. The chess set is very old, with wooden pieces that he made himself when he was a young man. One of the knights has a small crack in its head because I dropped it when I was five.

Grandfather learned the game from his own father in a small village in Poland. He says that chess is like life: you cannot move backwards, and every choice has a result. When I was little, I did not understand this, but now I think that I do.

At first, he won every game. I got angry and sometimes I threw a piece across the table. He never laughed at me. Instead, he showed me how to look at the board in a different way, thinking about what my opponent might do next.

Last month, I won a game for the very first time. Grandfather clapped his hands and said, "Now you are not just my grandson, you are my equal." I have never felt so proud. We are going to play again this Saturday, and I hope to win once more.

options: It came from a famous shop
It was a prize from a contest
questions.explanation: The pieces are wooden and he made them himself when he was young.

questions.explanation: The writer dropped it when he was five.

questions.explanation: Chess is like life: you cannot move backwards and every choice has a result.

He taught him a better way to look at the board
questions.explanation: He showed him how to look at the board in a different way.

parts.title: The story of chess
parts.instructions: Choose the sentence that fits each gap. There is one extra sentence.
parts.passage:
Chess is one of the oldest games in the world. [1] People first played it in India about fifteen hundred years ago, and the game then travelled along trade routes to Persia and Europe.

In the beginning, the pieces looked very different from the ones that we know today. [2] They were made to look like soldiers, elephants and horses, because the game was a small battle.

Over the centuries, the rules changed several times. [3] In the fifteenth century, the queen became the most powerful piece on the board, and the game became much faster.

Today, millions of people play chess, from children at school to famous champions. [4] Many of them play online against people from other countries.

Chess is also good for the brain. [5] Teachers say that pupils who play chess often get better marks in maths.
sentences: Its history is much longer than that of most sports.
Nobody was allowed to play it without the king's permission.
Experts say that it makes players think carefully and plan.
This change is still the biggest in the history of the game.
In fact, the internet has made the game more popular than ever.
Some of the early pieces were also made of ivory.

gaps.explanation: Its long history leads to the sentence about the first players in India.
Some early pieces were made of ivory, and the next sentence says they looked like soldiers and animals.
The change of the queen, with the biggest effect on the game, follows the changes in the rules.
The internet made the game more popular, and many people play online.
Experts say that chess makes players think and plan, and teachers say it helps maths marks.

parts.title: Why puzzles are good for you
parts.instructions: Write one word in each gap.
parts.passage: Many people enjoy doing puzzles, [1] they can also be good for you. When you do a crossword or a jigsaw, your brain has to work hard. This is a kind of exercise that can help you to remember things [2] easily. Puzzles can also help you to relax after a busy day. Some doctors even say that old people [3] do puzzles every day have a better memory. You do not need to spend a lot of money to start. A newspaper costs only a [4] pounds, and you can borrow jigsaws from the library. If you like to play with other people, you can [5] a puzzle night with your family. Choose a puzzle, set a timer, and see who can finish [6].

gaps.explanation: Many people enjoy puzzles, and they can also be good for you: addition.
More easily is the comparative of the adverb.
Old people who do puzzles: relative pronoun for people.
A few pounds means a small number of pounds.
Have a puzzle night means to organise one.
See who can finish first: it names the winner.

parts.title: A talk about chess
parts.instructions: Listen to the talk and complete each note with one word.

turns.speaker: roxana
turns.text: Good evening, everyone. Tonight, I would like to tell you a little about chess. It is played on a square board of sixty-four squares, in black and white. Each player starts with sixteen pieces, so there are thirty-two pieces on the board at the beginning. The most important piece is the king, because if you lose it, you lose the game. The most powerful piece is the queen, which can move in any direction for as many squares as it likes. A game of chess can last from a few minutes to many hours. The shortest possible game has only four moves, but it is very unusual. At the highest level, players think many moves ahead, and they sometimes use clocks, so each player has a limited amount of time. If you are new to the game, my advice is to start with simple openings and to practise every day. Playing against friends is the best way to improve.

gaps.explanation: It is played on a board of sixty-four squares.

gaps.prompt: At the beginning, there are ___ pieces on the board
gaps.explanation: Thirty-two pieces on the board at the beginning.

gaps.prompt: The most important piece is the ___
gaps.explanation: The most important piece is the king.

gaps.prompt: The most powerful piece is the ___
gaps.explanation: The most powerful piece is the queen.

gaps.prompt: Players sometimes use ___ to limit time

gaps.explanation: Playing against friends is the best way to improve.

parts.title: An interview with a puzzle maker
parts.instructions: Listen to the interview and choose the correct answer.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Delroy, you make puzzles for newspapers. How did you start?

turns.speaker: p
turns.text: I used to make crosswords for my classmates when I was twelve. A teacher saw one of them and sent it to a local newspaper, and they printed it.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: How long does it take to create a crossword?

turns.speaker: p
turns.text: A big one takes me about two days. The hardest part is to find words that fit together, and clues that are clever but not too difficult.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Where do you get your ideas?

turns.speaker: p
turns.text: From everyday life. A conversation in a café, a road sign, a film title. I always write them in a notebook, and later they become clues.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Do readers ever complain?

turns.speaker: p
turns.text: All the time! Once, I made a mistake, and thousands of people wrote to me. I learned to check every answer twice.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Do you solve puzzles in your free time?

turns.speaker: p
turns.text: Not really. After a day of puzzles, I prefer to go for a long walk with my dog, or to cook something with my wife.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: What would you tell someone who wants to be a puzzle maker?

turns.speaker: p
turns.text: Read a lot, because you need a rich vocabulary, and test your puzzles on friends before you send them away.
